title: One sell-side front-end — persona lenses over the market-making loop (GUI/Excel redesign)
description: The Celnet GUI + Excel redesign (docs/gui-redesign/, 16 mockup surfaces 00-shell … 15-rates-ticket) is one sell-side pricing/distribution/administration front-end built as persona lenses over a single market-making loop (feeds → pricing/model → contribution[LP-make] ⇄ RFQ/LP-take + sales-trader → books/positions → risk/XVA → ops; risk → skew). Every surface is a projection of the one canonical contract, per-asset-class-licensed off the engine entitlement kernel, with FI/rates a first-class peer, each cross-capability link tagged LIVE or TARGET honest to the code. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'single-front-end-experience'.

assertions.statement: The streaming LP-maker leg of the loop is wired end-to-end: attribution-resolved fills book into PositionStore::book_from_attribution, which the risk cube aggregates. This is the one genuinely-integrated loop leg the design renders LIVE.

The per-asset-class licensing primitive is engine-enforced: the celnet-entitlements capability kernel resolves Action × AssetClass × Desk with deny-wins-over-grant. The admin/license surface mirrors this kernel (present/gated/upsell); no client renders a ticket the engine will reject.

Every pricing surface is a projection of the one asset-class-parametric contract: FX/metal/equity/commodity/crypto and rates dispatch through price_instrument → engines::dispatch, never a per-class client fork. FI/rates is a peer asset class, not a siloed stack.

The front-end is persona lenses (quant/trader/sales-trader/risk-manager/desk-head) over one closed market-making loop with a Desk▸Book▸Underlier scope bus and saved perspectives — not 15 hard-mounted workspaces — rendered in the July-2026 SOTA design language, with every cross-capability link tagged honestly LIVE or TARGET.
